title: Reset failure
summary: A failed reset receipt names its failure: a check row's name and ok come from the operation, never nested evidence. When the server refuses a receipt, test_machine_operation_submit_failed repeats the host's error code, reason and recovery. A failed macOS reset keeps its first error code, and failed_calls records each failed call's exit code and bounded stderr, or its exception type and message; the runner's own SSH failure (exit 124) is test_mac_reset_transport_failed. Sign-in refusals (test_machine_sign_in_app_quit_not_proved, test_machine_sign_in_app_probe_failed when pgrep fails rather than finds no Safari) stop before anything is cleared, as do the Terminal refusals: test_machine_terminal_quit_not_proved when Terminal survives its quit and a forced kill of its window processes, and test_machine_terminal_probe_failed when pgrep fails. System Events is stopped alongside Terminal before clearing the home: test_machine_system_events_probe_failed means its process state could not be read; test_machine_system_events_quit_not_proved means it survived graceful quit and forced tree termination. Repair SSH/process access for an unreadable probe, or quit System Events in Activity Monitor at the host console, then retry reset. After a successful restore the reset relaunches Terminal without saved windows; test_machine_terminal_relaunch_failed means no window appeared. A harness probe whose reply the parser rejected keeps a sanitized reply_rejection record (rejection branch, event types, final event shape, exact-OK/tool-use/degraded-context booleans, harness exit code; never reply text) on its failed row; a QA run stores it as a probe_reply_rejection artifact and names the branch in its verdict reason. A golden sealed before these records returns none and its reason asks for a recapture. Linux golden archive receipts retain transport_diagnostics with private SSH client debug and sshd journal log paths, the operation window and journal collection status. Collection uses the existing SSH transport and a bounded noninteractive journal read. Inspect these logs before attributing SSH exit 255; an unavailable journal or warning alone does not prove a cause. Command payloads and capability secrets are redacted from retained logs. macOS reset emits success counters only after final process/load validation. A final-gate failure begins with the existing reap_processes phase marker and retains surviving reap failures, matching processes and measured load in process_state. This source correction does not diagnose historical failures, recover lost stdout or goldens, or prove a live host repair.
